This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/ Physical Mode).
2.
This I.A. has been filed seeking condonation of delay of one day in preferring this appeal.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the appellant has been convicted under Section 376 I.P.C. and has been sentenced to undergo RI for a period of 20 years.
He further contended that Petitioner is in custody from the date of his arrest.
4. Accordingly the delay of one day in preferring the appeal is hereby condoned.

6. List this matter next week.
( Aditya Kumar Mohapatra) Judge Rubi
